title: Oracle
tagline: Reads an encrypted message without ever having the key, by asking a server one yes/no question about two thousand times — a real padding-oracle attack against real hand-written AES, with every step animated and the app structurally unable to see the answer it's about to reveal

metrics.label: Oracle calls to recover one block — matching the theoretical average, asserted by test
Cryptographic primitives written from scratch — AES-128, SHA-256, HMAC, CBC, PKCS7
Network APIs present in the built bundle, enforced by a grep that fails CI
Runtime dependencies — react and react-dom, nothing else
